decisions.reason: Switching the downstream 5V LED rail does not alter the battery connector type, pin functions, part number, or unresolved pin order.
The 5V LED-rail control decision does not change battery overcharge, overdischarge, short-circuit, or protection-component requirements.
The source decision does not affect the battery NTC connection or thermal-monitoring behavior.
The switched 5V LED rail does not change USB data routing, enumeration, flashing, or standalone-programming support.
The interboard interface already routes 5V_EN on J_PWR_SIGNAL pin 7; using that existing signal for LED-rail shutdown does not change the connector or pinout state.
The eight-SK6812 addressable-LED board is assigned to the switched 5V rail, replacing its prior 3.3V supply and adding the rail-off standby policy.
